description: Google Drive is Google’s cloud file storage and synchronization service for storing, organizing, sharing, and accessing files. It is part of Google Workspace and also exposes developer APIs for working with Drive files and metadata.
summary: Google Drive exposes a documented REST API at `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3` and a documented Google Drive MCP server surface; both are described from Google Workspace developer docs, with OAuth 2.0 documented for the REST API and MCP authentication details not confirmed from the scraped pages.
